target.title: fix(agents): bound compaction planning worker payloads
target.body:
Addresses #100635

## What Problem This Solves

Compaction planning currently sanitizes private fields before worker handoff, but still sends full model-visible tool-result payloads through `workerData`. A single large browser/command result can therefore force multi-megabyte structured-clone work before the later summary-prompt truncation has a chance to help.

## Why This Change Was Made

This adds a planning-only projection for oversized tool-result text/content before worker handoff. The projection keeps a bounded UTF-16-safe sample for planning, records omitted model-visible characters, and keeps token-pressure accounting conservative so chunking/pruning decisions still treat the original payload as large.

The projection is applied only to worker planning inputs. Existing local fallback behavior and private-field sanitization remain unchanged.

## User Impact

Long sessions with very large tool outputs should spend less time and memory cloning redundant payload text into the compaction planning worker, reducing event-loop stall/OOM risk while preserving the compaction pressure signal.

## Evidence

- `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs run src/agents/compaction.token-sanitize.test.ts packages/agent-core/src/harness/compaction/compaction.test.ts` passed.
- `OPENCLAW_CHECK_CHANGED_REMOTE_CHILD=1 pnpm check:changed --base upstream/main --timed` passed.
- `pnpm build` passed on the rebased final HEAD.
- Microbenchmark, source projection:
  - 1 x 120k-char tool result: `120,134` bytes -> `8,436` bytes (`92.98%` reduction), tokens `30,000` -> `30,001`.
  - 65 x 40k-char tool results: `2,608,758` bytes -> `548,258` bytes (`78.98%` reduction), tokens `650,000` -> `650,065`.
- Built-worker smoke: projected 65 x 40k-char payloads through `dist/agents/compaction-planning.worker.js`; output did not contain the full huge text and retained token pressure (`650,000` -> `650,065`).

AI-assisted: yes. I reviewed the compaction planning and worker handoff paths, checked duplicate/open PR state for #100635, and validated the final branch locally.

Signed-off-by: Ho Lim <subhoya@gmail.com>
